GRB 970428 is a dark burst, and the radio afterglow is a short lived phenomenon.
the dark burst is not an exotic phenomenon, but rather a common one, and the dark burst phenomenon is not an obstacle to the standard GRB paradigm.

the radio detection of GRB 970829 was crucial to identify the host galaxy, which enabled us to measure its red-shift, z = 1.1, and to constrain the optical afterglows.
